name: artcraft_download_media_file
description: Download a media file to local disk (max 512 MB). The filename must be a plain file name (no directories); download_dir must be inside the user's home directory (or ARTCRAFT_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS). If the target file already exists, confirm: true is required to overwrite it.

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing file.

download_dir.description: Optional local directory under home/temp/ARTCRAFT_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS. Defaults to ~/Artcraft/downloads or the user downloads folder.

filename.description: Optional plain file name with extension (no path separators, max 128 chars)
